products.title: Basilisk Stack Loaded Leg Extension / Leg Curl
products.text: If you’re here, you’re above the whole “skipping leg day” thing. A dedicated leg machine ? No shortcuts. Big respect. A dedicated leg machine with a 310 LB stack and a strength curve we obsessed over for years? Now we’re talking. Most leg extension/curl combos in this class tap out around 250 lbs. The Basilisk gives you 210 or 310 — your call. Just getting started? Go 210. Planning to build Quads of the Gods? Go 310. And if you outgrow the 210, there's a 100 LB upgrade kit with your name on it (figuratively). But let’s be honest — the stack number isn’t the magic. The strength curve is. We didn’t just slap a cam on and call it a day. We fine-tuned the geometry and pivot points so extensions and curls feel right. Smooth where they should be. Challenging where they need to be. No weird dead spots. No “why does this feel off?” moments. Just clean resistance the whole way through. That 40% slope on the seat? Not random. It’s the sweet spot. We tested, we did the math (well...paid someone to). It puts your hip flexors where they need to be for quad isolation , and lines up your hamstrings properly for curls. We tested it. A lot. Probably more than we should admit. The result: it works. Fit-wise, we’ve got you covered.The back pad adjusts. Seat and leg positions adjust enough to fit lifters from 5'3" to 6'2" without feeling like a compromise. The leg holder gets out of your way when you need it to. And the stack can go left or right — because your gym layout should adjust to you. Not the other way around. Now let’s talk durability. Aluminum pulleys . TPU cable. Not sexy… until your machine doesn’t jam mid-set. Cheap machines bind. Cables wear out. That’s exactly why we built the Basilisk the way we did — smoother operation, longer lifespan, and backed by our no-nonsense warranty. We also kept the height low — on purpose. Tall machines waste vertical space. The Basilisk fits where commercial units won’t , which makes it just as at home in a garage as it is on a gym floor. And if you are running a facility, we’ve got custom logo plates and 60mm attachment compatibility ready to go. End result? You’re getting a machine that goes toe-to-toe with competitor options, only they charge $1,000–$2,000 more. Same features. Same performance. The only real difference? The logo. And we don’t charge extra for that.

products.text: As a generalist bar, The Utility Bar is designed for people who don't adhere to a particular strength sport and just love an excellent bar. With a 28.5mm diameter, it's just a tad thicker than an Olympic weightlifting bar (28mm diameter) and a smidge thinner than a powerlifting bar (29mm diameter). Brass bushings and no bearings make for a smooth rotation and an ultra-secure snap ring is used to keep it all together. A medium-light knurl won't chew your hands up when power cleaning, but it's complemented with centre knurling for a better grip when squatting. Featuring both weightlifting and powerlifting marks, hand positioning is made easy for whatever movement you're doing that day. Lightly ribbed sleeves help keep your weight plates from shifting during your workouts. Which version to choose? Black zinc: great protection, looks sharp, holds up well with minimal maintenance. Cerakote (not available in all markets): military-grade polymer coating that’s far more resistant to humidity and corrosion. If you train in a garage or basement with moisture and temperature swings, it's worth the upgrade. (Also, fun colour options.) Got smaller hands? You'll love the 25mm shaft & 15kg weight of the Juno Bar - Women's Utility Barbell . IMPORTANT: For cerakote-coated barbells, added care should be used to avoid abrasive metal-to-metal contact. Tight-fitting collars, weight plates, un-lined landmine attachments and j-cups, etc - these can potentially cut into or wear off the cerakote finish. Taking these extra precautions will preserve that beautiful rust-resistant finish for years to come!

products.title: Manticore Four Post Converter Bench
products.text: The four-post bench station is what you see at powerlifting meets and serious commercial gyms. products.text: Overview The Bells of Steel Cable Tower delivers full cable-machine functionality in a compact footprint under 2.5' × 2.5'—making it one of the most space-efficient cable systems available. With 30+ height settings, dual pull ratios (2:1 and 1:1), and your choice of plate-loaded, 110 lb or 210 lb selectorized stack, it's designed to give you commercial-level versatility without the size or cost of traditional cable machines. Why a Cable Tower Belongs in Your Gym Cable machines are one of the most versatile pieces of strength equipment you can own. Unlike fixed-path machines or barbells alone, cable systems allow for constant tension, free movement patterns, and joint-friendly resistance. The Cable Tower brings these benefits into a format designed specifically for home gyms—where space, flexibility, and value matter most. Whether you're training for strength, hypertrophy, rehab, or general fitness, a cable tower unlocks movements that are difficult or impossible to replicate with free weights alone. Built for Real Home Gym Constraints Many cable machines are designed for commercial gyms—large, heavy, and space-intensive. That's not practical for most home setups. The Bells of Steel Cable Tower is engineered differently. Compact footprint (~2.5' × 2.5') fits in tight spaces Multiple mounting options (rack, wall, or floor) adapt to your layout Low-profile design works in basements and garages. Instead of designing your gym around the machine, this machine fits into your gym. 110 lb mini stack option lets you pay for what you need, rather than paying for weight you won't use. Precision Adjustability One of the biggest limitations of many cable machines is limited adjustability. Fewer height settings mean compromised angles, awkward positioning, and less effective movements. With 30+ clearly numbered height settings, the Cable Tower allows you to: Dial in precise joint angles Maintain consistent setup between sessions Perform a wider range of exercises correctly This level of adjustability is typically found in higher-end commercial machines, but rarely in compact home gym towers. Who It's For Beginners Smooth resistance, lighter loading options, and adjustable angles make it easy to learn proper form safely. Intermediate Lifters Supports structured programming with consistent setups and a wide range of accessory movements. Advanced Athletes 1:1 heavy pulls, precise angles, and upgrade options make it ideal for targeted strength and hypertrophy work. Small-Space Home Gym Owners Perfect for garages, basements, apartments, and multi-use rooms thanks to its compact footprint. Coaches & Trainers Delivers the versatility of multiple cable machines without requiring the space or cost of a full commercial setup. Designed to Grow With Your Gym The Cable Tower isn't a one-dimensional machine—it's a foundation piece. Compatible with standard cable attachments Works alongside rack attachments and accessories Supports progression from beginner to advanced training As your training evolves, the Cable Tower adapts with you—so you won't outgrow it. Choose the Right Loading Style Selectorized Mini Weight Stack (110 lb) Economical without sacrificing functionality Benefits of 210 lb stack without the cost Ideal for new lifters Selectorized Weight Stack (210 lb) Fast, convenient pin adjustments Ideal for circuits, supersets, and shared use Clean and efficient workflow Plate-Loaded Version Unlimited loading potential Lower upfront cost Ideal for users who already own plates All options use the same core system, footprint, and adjustability—so your choice comes down to preference, not limitations. Exercise Variety Upper Body Lat pulldown Seated cable row Face pull Triceps pushdown Cable curl Chest fly (high, mid, low) Lateral raise Straight-arm pulldown Lower Body Cable pull-through Romanian deadlift Split squat Glute kickback Cable hamstring curl Hip abduction/adduction Core Cable crunch Pallof press Woodchopper (high-to-low / low-to-high) Anti-rotation holds Functional / Athletic Cable punches Rotational presses Resistance walkouts This versatility is why many lifters consider a cable tower one of the most-used pieces in their gym. Dual Pull Ratios Not all cable systems feel the same—and pull ratio plays a huge role in how they perform. The Cable Tower gives you both: 2:1 Ratio → smoother, lighter resistance for accessory work 1:1 Ratio (with adapter) → full resistance for heavy lifts This means you can move seamlessly between high-rep accessory work, isolation movements, and heavy strength-focused exercises. Instead of needing multiple machines, you get a full spectrum of resistance in one system. Smooth Cable Feel A cable machine is only as good as how it feels during use. The Cable Tower is designed to deliver smooth pulley rotation, consistent cable tension, and minimal friction during movement. Combined with its rigid frame (when properly mounted), this creates a training experience users often describe as "commercial-feel" in a home gym setup. For those looking to further refine performance, optional upgrades (like aluminum pulleys) can enhance smoothness even more.

products.title: Deadlift Bar
products.text: The Bells of Steel Deadlift Bar has one job: help you yank ungodly weight off the floor, and then come back for more. Unlike a traditional 29mm power bar designed to handle squats, bench press, and deadlifts, this 27mm deadlift-specific bar is longer and intentionally “whippier,” allowing the shaft to flex before the plates fully break from the ground. That flex isn’t a gimmick; it raises your starting position slightly, lets you engage your hips and posterior chain before the full load hits, and helps experienced lifters ramp into heavy weight instead of getting crushed by it all at once. The thinner diameter can also improve grip feel, while the absence of a center knurl saves your shins during aggressive pulls. Deadlift bars are commonly used in strongman competitions and many powerlifting federations. The deadlift bar is a specialty performance upgrade for lifters who already know the deadlift is their money lift. Chasing PRs? Training for strongman? Stepping on the platform? Or just emotionally attached to loading more plates than your friends? Good. This deadlift bar is for you.

products.title: Open Trap Bar / Hex Bar
products.text: Overview The Bells of Steel Open Trap Bar is a highly versatile strength-training tool engineered for deadlifts, rows, carries, lunges, squats, RDLs, presses, and dozens of accessory movements—without beating up your back in the process. Its open design, integrated deadlift jack, dual handle heights with neutral grip placement, compact and stable build make it easier to use, easier to load, and easier to control than traditional hex bars. Built from high-strength steel with fully knurled handles, it delivers premium quality and performance at a home-gym-friendly price — offering unmatched value compared to competitors' alternatives. Whether you're brand new, chasing PRs, or getting back under the bar after a "life happened" phase, this bar is a must-have tool in your training arsenal. Why Choose an Open Trap Bar? Open trap bars have become the modern standard because they solve problems older hex bars can't: Improved movement freedom (lunges, rows, carries, split squats) Safer mechanics for beginners learning hinge patterns Easier loading due to the built-in jack designs Better ergonomics for tall, long-limbed, or mobility-limited lifters Full-body use instead of just deadlifts The BOS Open Trap Bar takes all of these advantages and delivers them with balanced geometry, premium knurling, and durability — without the inflated price tag. Who It's For Beginners The high handles, stable frame, and balanced center-mass make learning the deadlift safer and more controlled. Beginners also benefit from the open design for lunges and split squats. Intermediate Lifters Switch quickly between lifts using the dual-handle setup and easy loading. Ideal for accessory work programmed between barbell lifts. Advanced Lifters & Strength Athletes Rated for 700 lbs with knurled handles and a rigid frame designed for maximal pulls. Perfect for heavy deadlifts, RDLs, shrugs, and loaded carries. Small-Space & Garage Gym Users A single tool that replaces multiple specialty training tools without requiring extra storage space. The open design gives you more movement variety in tight spaces. Coaches, Trainers & Home-Gym Power Users One bar supports hinge mechanics, bilateral work, rows, carries, gait patterns, and accessory-strength programming for a wide range of clients. Ease of Use Built-In Deadlift Jack Tilt the bar onto its feet, and slide plates on effortlessly. This drastically reduces setup fatigue and keeps the bar stable while loading heavy weights. Easy to Maneuver The open design reduces awkwardness during movement transitions. The centered load path makes every movement feel smoother and more predictable. Beginner-Friendly Learning Curve High handles + stable frame + good knurl = ideal for teaching hinge mechanics or returning to pulling after injury. Value & Cost Efficiency Buying separate bars for deadlifts, farmer carries, rows, and split squats quickly becomes expensive. The Open Trap Bar replaces: Hex bar Carry handles Row bar Farmer carry implements Multiple specialty attachments Durability & Longevity Premium Build Quality This bar is engineered to endure years of high-volume training cycles. Welds are strong, sleeves spin smoothly, and the frame is built to maintain alignment under repeated loading. Improved Packaging Updated packaging protects your bar during transport, so it arrives shiny and new—the way it should. Low-Maintenance Finish Simply wipe down between sessions to resist moisture and sweat buildup. Engineering & Construction Balanced, Stable Geometry The bar's centerline is engineered for balance, reducing forward roll and side-to-side wobble during carries, rows, and heavy pulls. Multiple reviewers specifically highlight how unexpectedly balanced the bar feels compared to cheaper models. High-Strength Steel Frame Built from rigid steel designed to stay stable under load. The bar is rated to 700 lbs and maintains its shape even during heavy deadlifts. Dual Handle Heights Low handles replicate the standard barbell pulling height, while high handles offer reduced range of motion, easier setup for beginners, and safer pulls for lifters with mobility limitations. Fully Knurled Handles Both handle sets are knurled end-to-end for a consistent, confident grip without being overly aggressive. Reviewers frequently call out the knurling as one of the standout features. Durable, Protective Finish A reinforced coating helps limit chips, scuffs, and wear from daily use. Improved packaging helps prevent dents and dings during transport. Sleeves for Standard Plates Compatible with Olympic-style plates (50 mm sleeves), including bumper plates, steel plates, and change plates. Full-Body Versatility Unlike closed hex bars that feel "locked in," the open side unlocks dozens of movements: Lower Body Deadlifts RDLs Squats & squat variations Lunges & reverse lunges Split squats Step-ups Trap-bar jumps Upper Body Seal rows Bent-over rows Press-outs Iso holds Loaded Conditioning Farmer carries Suitcase carries Marches & gait patterns Strongman-style conditioning circuits The open design dramatically increases the training value of a single bar — making this one of the most cost-efficient specialty bars you can own.

products.title: Adjustable Competition Kettlebell
products.text: Overview The Adjustable Competition Kettlebell is a precision-engineered strength tool designed for lifters who want the full weight range of an entire kettlebell set in one beautiful bell—without sacrificing space, feel, or durability. Talk about an overachiever. Built with a steel shell, iron plates, 0.5 kg micro-loading, true competition shape and size, and up to 41 weight intervals in one bell, it delivers the exact performance of fixed kettlebells in a modular, space-saving format. Unlike quick-adjust dial systems that rely on plastic components and age like milk, this bell prioritizes stability, longevity, and premium commercial-grade construction, making it the ideal choice for serious home gym owners, minimalist training spaces, and athletes who demand uncompromising performance, no matter what they (Turkish) get up to. IMPORTANT: The Adjustable Kettlebell is a fantastic tool, but it is not recommended when a fast transition of sizes is needed since changing the weights takes 1-2 minutes. If you need two different weights for swings and overhead work, we recommend getting two adjustable kettlebells for sale — you save 10% when you buy a pair. Who It's For Beginners Micro-loading and optional lighter-start add-ons make early progression smoother and safer. Perfect for learning kettlebell fundamentals with proper form. Intermediate Lifters 41 weight settings enable continuous progression for full-body strength training. Switch between swings, cleans, presses, squats, and accessory work without needing multiple bells. Advanced Athletes True competition sizing, balanced geometry, and 0.5 kg precision jumps allow refined technique, double-bell programming, and plateau breaking—ideal for serious kettlebell practitioners. Small-Space Home Gyms & Apartments Replace an entire rack of kettlebells in the footprint of a single bell. Highly portable, compact, and quiet enough for multi-unit living. Coaches & Personal Trainers While not recommended for classes, the wide adjustability supports multiple clients with different strength levels using a single piece of equipment. Premium Build & Materials Every component is chosen for commercial durability: Steel Shell: maintains perfect geometry across all weights Iron Plates: machined to tight tolerances for consistent balance Steel-on-Steel Locking System: no fragile plastic, no gimmicks Competition Handle (35 mm): consistent grip feel at any load Balanced Bell Cavity: ensures predictable swing paths and smooth transitions The result is an adjustable system that feels indistinguishable from a fixed kettlebell—something customers repeatedly confirm in reviews. Weight Range & Micro-Loading With 41 possible weight settings from 12–32 kg, the Adjustable Competition Kettlebell gives you full control over your progression. Why Micro-Loading Matters Most adjustable kettlebells jump in 1–2 kg increments (or larger), forcing lifters into uncomfortable leaps. This bell offers 0.5 kg micro-loading, allowing: Smoother strength progression Safer jumps for beginners More precise overload for advanced athletes Fine-tuned programming for kettlebell complexes Easier weight matching during unilateral accessory work This is one of the product's biggest advantages over the competition. Plastic Bottom Add-On: Lighter Weights, More Versatility Many users require access to lighter ranges for curls, shoulder prehab, warm-ups, or accessory training. The Plastic Bottom Add-On solves this by reducing the bell to a 9 kg base, with plate configurations enabling 9.5–11.5 kg. Perfect for: Single-arm curls Preacher curls Shoulder rehab/prehab Beginners learning kettlebell technique Accessory isolation movements It essentially expands the product downward, offering a true full-range kettlebell system from 9–32 kg. Stability & Internal Movement Many competitor bells rattle and shake, creating instability and distraction during exercise. This bell minimizes shifting through: Precision-cut iron plates Tight internal fitment A secure locking system A stable cavity shape engineered to reduce noise Most users describe the feel as "solid," "stable," and "built like a tank." How It Compares to Other Adjustable Kettlebells Feature Adjustable Competition KB Typical Adjustable KBs Weight Range 12–32 kg (expandable to 9–32 kg w/ add-on) 16–24 kg or limited ranges Increment Size 0.5 kg micro-loading 1–2 kg jumps or fixed stops Construction All-metal steel + iron Often uses plastic components Geometry True competition standards Varies; many non-standard shapes Adjustment System Secure steel-on-steel, durable Fast-but-fragile dial systems Feel During Use Matches fixed kettlebells Often unbalanced or hollow-feeling Space Requirements Replaces 41 bells Replaces fewer bells Portability Easy to transport; modular Often bulky or awkward This positions the product as a premium, competition-grade adjustable kettlebell system—built for real training, not just convenience. Adjustment Experience The bell is designed for durability over speed. Typical adjustment time: 60–90 seconds Optimized for safety, stability, and longevity—not fast but fragile mechanisms Easy learning curve after first few uses Clear plate stacking and labeling for intuitive weight setup A short setup between sets is normal—and ensures the bell lasts for years under heavy use. Competition Geometry & Feel This is where it separates itself from dial-adjustable systems. Fixed-width 35 mm handle ensures consistent grip familiarity Standardized window size keeps movements smooth Uniform bell shape mimics fixed competition kettlebells across all weights Maintains predictable pull paths in snatches, swings, cleans, Turkish get-ups, push presses, and jerks Lifters repeatedly confirm that it "feels like a real comp bell," a key differentiator from Bowflex-style or cast-iron adjustable alternatives. Versatility & Training Applications The Adjustable Competition Kettlebell supports every major kettlebell movement: Two-hand and single-hand swings Cleans & clean variations Snatches Turkish get-ups Presses, push presses, & jerks Goblet squats & front-loaded squats Deadlifts, rows, & high pulls Lunges & step-ups Windmills & core anti-rotation work Conditioning complexes Accessories with lighter weight ranges (via plastic bottom add-on ) You effectively replace an entire progression system with one modular tool. Space & Portability Fits easily in apartments, condos, small home gyms Travels easily (remove plates and pack flat) Ideal for lifters who want serious training without dedicated storage racks Minimal noise—reviewers consistently describe it as "quiet enough for apartments" Warranty & Support Your Adjustable Competition Kettlebell is backed by: Lifetime shell warranty Responsive, top-rated customer service Clear online setup support A community of lifters who stand behind the product Built for performance. Originally made famous by sailing rigs (aye aye, Captain), these mighty little marvels have nestled into the heart of the home gym community for good reason. Without one, the cable on your cable machine absorbs every twist, turn, and awkward angle you throw at it. Eventually, this can cause cable twists & binds, causing even more unnecessary stress on your gym gear. But slap on Swivel Shackles and BOOM — your cable attachments rotate freely, torque vanishes, and your cables breathe a sigh of relief. This means no more weird angles on attachments that just don’t quite line up… looking at you, 30-D Handle Bar . Some savvy lifters clip a swivel shackle to every cable attachment they own. But if you prefer, just keep one permanently attached to the actual cable end(s) of your machine. They’re super simple to use, so handle swaps are quick and easy. These aren’t some dollar-store knockoffs, either. We handpicked a premium grade that boasts a 450kg weight capacity. That’s strong enough to handle your cable attachments, your next PR, and our trauma from being picked last in gym class. And unlike other sellers who bake full shipping costs into every pair, we hand-pick and ship all your shackles together, so the cost only increases slightly per pair. This means you get more gear without getting dinged at checkout. IMPORTANT: Sold as a set of 4 or 8 shackles.

products.title: Residential Bumper Plate Tree
products.text: Tired of playing plate Jenga in your home gym? The Residential Bumper Plate Tree is your budget-friendly solution to weight plate chaos, handling up to 858lbs of weight without the higher price tag of commercial-grade options. Crafted from 14-gauge steel with a 57lb weight, this unit is sturdy enough for most lifters, while the rubber feet keep your floors safe from battle scars. Plus, the four welded bar holders mean your barbells can finally stop napping on the floor. (They’ve been through enough.) The tree's tubing holes allow you to adjust the height of the plate pegs to match your plate collection, whether you're rocking bumpers or a complete set of iron plates. Each plate peg on the tree offers 12-1/2" of loadable space — plenty of room to stack up to three 45lb crumb bumper plates per peg. When spaced evenly, you can load a bumper on every peg without them overlapping or playing bumper cars. With smaller bolts than our other models, this plate tree is easy to assemble but is still rock-solid. And yeah, no wheels means no rolling, but c’mon… if you wanted cardio, you’d be on a treadmill . IMPORTANT: Barbells and plates sold separately.

products.text: It's time to bump up your lifting game. These crumb bumper plates have a thick stainless steel insert ring with 3 anchor points to prevent common bumper breakdowns. The crumb material is quieter than urethane bumpers. Ideal for lifters who don't have a platform and features coloured flecks for easier weight identification. The number one advantage of bumpers is safety for the lifter. A lifter who hesitates to dump a bad lift because they're afraid of damage to the floor or the equipment is more likely to get hurt. Bumpers take any worry about damage completely out of the equation. Iron plates come in a variety of non-standardized diameters, so if you are doing any exercises pulling from the floor, such as deadlifts, or cleans, unless you have 45lb plates on each side, you'll be pulling from a deficit. Not the case here. Cheap bumpers can be up to 10% off the claimed weight, causing you to put the wrong weight on the bar. Our bumper plates are accurate to +/- 1% of the claimed weight. No more second-guessing what's on the bar - ever. NOTE: We're discontinuing the 55 LBS plates, so grab yours while supplies last. The Crumb Bumpers are RoHS-compliant.

products.text: Overview The Smith Machine Rack Attachment turns your existing rack — Hydra, Manticore, 84" Light Commercial, or most 2.3"–3" racks — into a smooth, guided Smith machine without stealing a single extra inch of floor space. Sneaky, right? Pick the classic built-in Smith bar, or go BYOB (Bring Your Own Barbell) and run your favorite bar inside the guided rails. You get the safety and consistency of a Smith, plus the familiar feel of the bar you already know and love. More control, more confidence, fewer "please don't let this rep be the one that takes me out" moments. Recommended Set-Up: Mount the upper brackets to the top of your uprights & the lower brackets to your crossmembers (inside rack) or front foot stabilizers (outside rack). Brackets can be mounted to your uprights only, but a dropped bar could permanently damage the unit. Who It's For Beginners — Guided bar path builds confidence and reduces risk while learning core movements like squats, bench, and presses. Intermediate Lifters — Train heavy without a spotter, maintain consistent form, and use higher volume safely. Advanced Athletes — Use it for hypertrophy work, accessory lifting, pre-exhaust sets, and high-rep training where stability matters. Small-Space Home Gym Owners — Get full Smith machine functionality without dedicating 4–6 feet of floor space to a standalone machine. Couples / Households with Mixed Experience Levels — The fixed bar path makes lifting safer and more accessible for partners new to strength training. Rack Owners Who Don't Want to Replace Their Setup — Add a Smith machine to your existing rack — no need to buy a new cage or proprietary setup. Exercises — Lower Body Squats Split squats / Bulgarian split squats Lunges Hack squat variations Calf raises Exercises — Upper Body Flat bench press Incline bench press Decline press Shoulder press Upright rows Iso-lateral bench press (Anvil Handles) Iso-lateral shoulder press (Anvil Handles) Single-arm rows (Anvil Handles) Exercises — Back & Accessory Work Smith machine rows Hip hinges / RDL variations Shrugs Exercises — Core Smith machine ab roll variations Kneeling Smith machine core drags Compatibility — Bells of Steel Racks The Bar Included version also fits 47" wide racks by placing the spacers on the inner side of each mounting bracket — watch this video for more compatibility details. products.title: Curved Squat Bar
products.text: So you’ve been in the gym squatting and benching like there’s no tomorrow and hitting all the PR’s. But all that huge weight you’ve been slangin’ around is beatin’ up your shoulders & elbows. Enter the Curved Squat Bar. This isn’t just some super-bent bar. The Curved Squat Bar is strategically designed to alleviate stress from your wrists, elbows, and shoulders while squatting and benching. Similar to a traditional straight barbell , you grip the bar like a proper squat or bench but with significantly less pressure on your joints. It’s the perfect bar for off-season training and one of the best options for pushing up your volume during your competitive season without as much joint strain. And unlike a Safety Squat Bar , the Curved Squat Bar can be used for upper body movements—like the bench press! It adds several inches to your range of motion to help strengthen your press of the chest and assist with muscular development. IMPORTANT: The Curved Squat Bar is significantly longer, thicker, and heavier than a typical Olympic barbell. To avoid the bar flipping when racked, sandwich j-cups are strongly recommended.

With a burly 700lb capacity, this spotter system has your back during heavy squats, letting you safely bail if things go awry. Or throw on some handles and complement the heavy days with inverted rows, chest presses, core work, and more. Don't just exercise; suspend your disbelief and redefine what's possible in your home gym! The Suspension Spotter Straps and Bodyweight System is a complete system that includes the following: - A pair of Suspension Straps with a chain, clip, and shackle for easy height adjustment. - Rack protector straps with a triangulated steel piece at the bottom to slide your suspension straps into easily. - Pair of handles with four rings for height adjustment and a thick rubber handle.

Convenient lockable wheels make your loaded storage rack easy to move around, so you don't waste valuable energy walking a few steps across the gym (ew, cardio.) The burly 661lb max capacity gives you a solid lifting goal to aim for. White lights all the way, babyyy.

The precision grip handles make loading plates onto the bar and re-racking plates a breeze, and they're large enough for even huge hands. The comfort grip also allows the plates themselves to be used for exercises like steering wheels and farmers' carries. These plates are excellent quality iron plates made in a factory with over 40 years of casting experience. Because they are only cast and not machined, some minor blemishes and a +/-3% weight tolerance / 51mm hole are standard in the plates.If you're looking for a precision fit and machined-to-perfection plate, be sure to check out our Machined Iron Plates. IMPORTANT: Because they're cast iron instead of machined, some minor blemishes, +/-3% weight tolerance & 51mm hole are standard for them.

products.text: Designed to catch your eye, while adding to the lifespan of your home gym. These non-smelly, coloured bumper plates have a thick stainless steel insert ring with 3 anchor points to prevent common bumper breakdowns. Coloured bumpers are not just aesthetically pleasing, they offer additional functionality. It can often be frustrating trying to quickly and easily identify the plates you need for your workout. With their eye-catching colours, this is no longer an issue with the Coloured Bumper Plates. Iron plates come in a variety of non-standardized diameters, so if you are doing any exercises pulling from the floor, such as deadlifts, or cleans, unless you have 45lb plates on each side, you'll be pulling from a deficit. Cheap bumpers can be up to 10% off the claimed weight, causing you to put the wrong weight on the bar. Our bumper plates are accurate to +/- 1% of the claimed weight. No more second-guessing what's on the bar - ever.

products.text: Don't let the name fool you: this bodybuilding classic targets the back, triceps, biceps, and more. Built for progression, this steel contraption has 7 springs with carabiner attachments, so you can remove or double up springs, adjusting the tension to suit your goals and experience level. The chest expander offers consistent tension throughout the movement regardless of how many springs are attached, making it optimal over bands for bodybuilding. products.title: The Dreadmill
products.text: The Dreadmill is a lean, hyper-versatile, dread dream machine! This 3-in-1 cardio machine is a farmer walk, sled push, and manual incline treadmill — all rolled into one. Applying resistance is easy and smooth, thanks to the magnetic resistance lever. By positioning magnets near the flywheel, resistance is generated without any physical contact, ensuring nearly whisper-quiet operation. Keep it low and light, or crank up the intensity for serious athletic gainzzz. Whether you're warming up, crushing intervals, or tackling endurance training, the Dreadmill's magnetic resistance lever makes it easy to adjust your workouts instantly. Being self-powered, you’re free to roam away from outlets. Simply lift from the front stabilizer bar to engage the rear wheels and claim a new home base. The Dreadmill requires very little maintenance aside from the occasional dusting and belt lubricating — don’t mind the jealous looks from your motorized machine-owning friends. It folds away to save space, and you can even use the farmer walk handles to mimic Lever Arm exercises! Bust out bent-over rows, bench presses, shrugs, split squats, calf raises, shoulder presses, and deadlift variations. Best of all, you can get up to speed with all The Dreadmill’s utility in a single workout. Sorry, Wooden Manual Treadmill — there’s barely any learning curve here.

products.text: The Blitz Air Rower is an economical indoor rowing machine that offers a joint-friendly, full-body workout with a wide range of training potential. This low-impact cardio machine has a lower impact than running and skipping, so it's ideal for people with joint issues. The air-powered flywheel and adjustable damper give you control over the intensity of your workout-the harder you row, the more resistance you'll get. The ergonomic design and adjustable footrests make it easy to use, and the quick disassembly and front-mounted wheels make it easier to put away after your sweat session. Version 2: Features an additional carabiner clip, so you can swap out the default handle for any cable attachment .

products.title: Reverse Hammer 2 In 1 GHD And Reverse Back Extension
products.text: The Reverse Hammer is two essential products for your home gym - Reverse Back Extension & Glute Ham Developer (GHD) - combined into one, at a fraction of the cost (and space) of separate machines. The fusion of the Reverse Back Extension machine and Glute Ham Developer (GHD) is a Bells of Steel original design and was engineered in-house. The Reverse Back Extension is an excellent movement for the lower back, glutes, and hamstrings because it allows one to train the whole of the posterior chain in a way that is very similar to the deadlift, but without actually loading up the spine. This makes the Reverse Back Extension the perfect movement for athletes with a pre-existing low back issue or those who want to give their lower back a break without missing a training session. Meanwhile, the Glute Ham Raise is an incredibly useful exercise for isolating the hamstrings and the glutes, increasing hypertrophy to these two essential muscle groups. It's also believed to be superior to the leg curl because it works more muscles and puts a greater emphasis on the eccentric component of knee flexion. Increased time under tension, a more complete range of motion, and the ability to add resistance with bands or weight plates make for a very targeted approach to hamstring and glute development that will carry over to your heavy squats, deadlifts, and your explosiveness on the playing field. It features a vertically adjustable footplate/foot roller carriage that accommodates users of any height. The diamond-plate platforms facilitate stepping up into the GHD, with a removable crotch pad so the fellas don’t damage the goods. Side handles make getting in and out easier, and extra padding over the curved part of the pad for more comfortable reverse back extensions. Add cable attachments and resistance bands for upper body work and build lower body strength, power, and explosiveness without putting your spine through a heavy-duty stress test.

products.text: Vertical storage is like a pillar of perfection, nay, a beacon of hope, of home gym storage. While we love the rack-mountable plate pegs, we also appreciate wanting more space for attachments. The Wall Mounted Plate Storage Rack is the best of both worlds. This space-saving storage solution mounts directly to a stud or concrete wall to keep your plates tidy and secure. Four 12.6″ plate pegs and a 793lb total capacity offer plenty of space for your weight plates with 2" holes. Customize the peg spacing to show off your collection in style. You don't just have to store plates on this, built with the same 2.3 x 2.3 inch tubing power racks, you can also store your rack attachments when not in use, like your dip bar, band pegs, seal row pad and whatever your heart desires. Hardware included. Ships unassembled. IMPORTANT: For user and equipment safety, the Wall-Mounted Plate Storage MUST be bolted to a wall stud or into a concrete wall.

products.title: Leg Press Hack Squat Machine
products.text: The barbell squat is a cornerstone. It's also loading your spine every single rep. A dedicated leg press hack squat machine keeps the legs in the equation and takes the spine out of it for more volume, more frequency, less negotiating with your lower back about whether today is actually a training day. The B.o.S. Leg Press + Hack Squat Machine is two machines in one footprint (plus a bonus third if you count calf raises, which we do) and it hits quads, hamstrings, glutes, and calves without negotiating with your rack for time. Flip the footplate, reposition the back pad, and you're in a completely different exercise. One verified reviewer clocked the switchover at under 30 seconds. (Not a drill. Legs were on fire shortly after. Burn baby, burn .) 1,000 LBS / 454 KG CAPACITY across every angle: leg press, hack squat , calf raise. The sled rides on LINEAR BALL BEARINGS, not bushings, not roller wheels, which is why it glides instead of grinds. The frame carries a LIFETIME WARRANTY . Moving parts: 3 years. Pads: 1 year. (The competition gives you 12 months on the whole machine and hopes you don't notice.) 5 racking positions for lifters of every height. Multiple footplate angle settings for both exercises. Band pegs built in: loop on a set of resistance bands to make the top of every rep heavier, which is exactly where most lifters cheat their gains. Plates store neatly under the sled, so the 87" / 221 cm x 37” / 95.3 cm footprint stays sleek. Highly recommended by lifters like you. The recurring word in 5-star reviews is "tank." The recurring word in the 4-star reviews? "Wish I had a friend to help assemble it" — which is fair, because at 322 LBS / 146 KG across 6 boxes, this is a buddy-system build, which happens when something is built for the big leagues. (Plan for 2–4 hours and a second set of hands.) Looking for other ways to put the “Leg” in “LEGendary?” The Belt Squat Machine lets you load your legs without loading your back. And if hamstring curl and leg extension work is on the list, the Basilisk Leg/ Curl Extension rounds out the full leg day lineup without needing another room. Ships fast from where you are: Calgary and Toronto for Canada (capped at $199 CAD flat-rate or pick-up at our showrooms to save), Melbourne for Australia (capped at $199 AUD flat-rate, no duties or customs, or pick up at our showroom to save), Bristol for the UK (free over £99, no duties or customs). Proudly Canadian. Genuinely global. Add to cart and stop skipping leg day. IMPORTANT : Assembling the Leg Press Hack Squat Machine is challenging due to the weight and size of the boxes and components. Having a friend to help is strongly recommended.

products.title: Viking Press Attachment
products.text: A barbell and a rack? Everyone has that. A Viking press landmine attachment in the corner? That's a different gym... and a different kind of shoulder day. Dust off the beater bar. Drop it into a landmine , load plates, slide the attachment over the sleeve, lock the knob. You're doing the viking press exercise in under a minute, no Strongman meet required. The neutral grip positions stack your elbows directly under your wrists, keeping the shoulder joint in its happy place through the full range of motion; more pressing, fewer "I'll sit this one out" Mondays. Heavy steel frame. Rust-resistant black powder coat. A locking knob that doesn't wobble mid-rep (looking at you, slide-over sleeves). Built to last, priced like it isn't. That's the B.o.S. thing. The reviews speak for themselves. One lifter called it "the one thing I was really missing." Another said it kicked their butt harder than anything they'd touched in a long time. We'll take both. The viking press exercise is just the headline. The real value? This is a 5-exercise kit in disguise. Landmine shoulder press. Single-arm row. Meadows press. T-bar row. Half-kneeling press. One attachment, an entire shoulder-and-back day, and it all slides onto a 2" Olympic bar you probably already own. Verified reviews. Near-perfect rating. Don't have a landmine yet? We've got those too. Need to piece together the rest of your setup? Use the Home Gym Builder tool and save 5%. Otherwise, add it to your cart and get Strongman pressing in your garage by next week. IMPORTANT: Please note that the locking screw that secures the Viking Press Attachment to your bar could mark up your barbell sleeve over time. products.title: Competition Kettlebells
products.text: A mismatched pile of cast iron says you bought whatever was on sale. A clean ladder of identical bells says you're actually training. Competition kettlebells aren't just a step up in quality; they're a completely different class of tool. Here's the thing nobody explains until you've already bought the wrong bell: the size never changes. 11" / 280 mm tall, 8.2" / 210 mm across, same on the 12 KG, same on the 32 KG, same on the 48 KG. The wall gets thicker as the weight goes up. The bell doesn't. So when you move up in weight, it sits in the same spot on your forearm and lands in the same place on the floor. Every time. One reviewer put it better than we would: "These are amazing quality and I love how they are all the same size so no matter the weight they feel the same in my hand." - Patrick M., verified buyer SIXTEEN WEIGHTS. 4 KG TO 48 KG. All colour-coded, all marked in both KG and LB on the face. One ladder you never outgrow. Not sure which weight to start with? The kettlebell weight guide breaks it down for every level. TWO HANDLE SPECS. BOTH COMPETITION CLASS. These bells meet legal Girevoy Sport Union (GSU), IKFF, and International Union of Kettlebell Lifting (IUKL) standards. The 10-48 KG bells run a 60 mm window and 35 mm handle, the required international competition size, built for a relaxed grip and zero knuckle cramping. The 4, 6, and 8 KG step to a 58 mm window and 34 mm handle, sized for beginners and smaller hands. A 12-year-old on the 6 KG and a lifter chasing rank on the 32 KG are holding the same class of bell, just sized to their hands. GRAVITY CAST. ONE PIECE. NO WELDS. No seam, no filler packed in to hit a number. The core is hollow, which is why the weight sits where it should and why there's nothing rattling around inside. A buyer on his third bell: "These bells are perfectly weighted, love the hollow core gravity cast design. They are perfectly balanced and feel superb." - Blair D., verified buyer UNMATCHED WEIGHT ACCURACY. ±200 g / 0.44 lb on every bell from 10-48 KG. ±100 g / 0.22 lb on the 4, 6, and 8 KG. Our own powder coat line runs ±300 g. Most of the competition publishes nothing at all, which is its own kind of answer. Want to understand the difference between competition and standard bells before you decide? We wrote the explainer . 4.9 stars. The reviews keep landing on two things: they came from mismatched cast iron and aren't going back, and they're working their way up the ladder. Want the full ladder without the full footprint? The Adjustable Competition Kettlebell gives you up to 41 weight intervals in one bell for the same competition shape, same feel, same quality, same Limited Lifetime Warranty. One bell to rule them all.

products.text: Overview The Buzz-Saw Bench is a heavy-duty adjustable bench engineered for lifters who prioritize stability, pad performance, and long-term durability over unnecessary gimmicks. Built from thick 11-gauge steel with a reinforced stabilizer foot and a high-density, stay-put pad, it delivers that locked-in confidence you want when the weight gets spicy — without stealing your floor space or your grocery money. The seat adjusts independently to support proper torso positioning across flat and incline configurations, helping reduce lower-back strain and improve pressing mechanics. Despite its solid weight and premium feel, integrated wheels and a front handle make repositioning the bench quick and manageable within a home gym. Pad Design & Lifting Feel Unlike softer, overly cushioned benches that compress unpredictably, the Buzz-Saw Bench pad is tuned for firm support with controlled grip. Maintains shape under heavy loads Prevents sliding during aggressive leg drive Comfortable across high-rep and heavy single sessions A minimal pad gap between seat and backrest helps maintain comfort during flat and incline transitions without interfering with range of motion. Space, Assembly & Practical Considerations The Buzz-Saw Bench is designed to fit comfortably in most home gym layouts without sacrificing stability. Assembly is straightforward with clearly labeled hardware, and the bench arrives mostly pre-assembled to reduce setup time. Its balance of heft and mobility makes it easy to reposition between lifts while remaining rock-solid once in place.
